headline.zh: Meta 推出 Muse Glimmer：專為常駐型本地 Agent 優化的 30B 開源模型
headline.en: Meta introduces Muse Glimmer, a 30B open model optimized for always-on local agents

detail.zh: Meta 推出 30B 參數的 Muse Glimmer，主打低資源消耗與常駐型（always-on）Agent 工作流。開放權重設計讓開發者能在本地硬體順暢執行自動化 Agent，無須依賴雲端 API。
detail.en: Meta released Muse Glimmer, a 30B parameter open-weight model designed specifically for low-latency, always-on local agent workflows. This allows developers to run autonomous agents on local hardware without cloud API dependencies.

headline.zh: Docker 推出 Docker Sandboxes：為 AI Agent 提供一次性隔離安全沙盒
headline.en: Docker launches Docker Sandboxes for disposable, isolated AI agent execution

detail.zh: Docker Sandboxes 提供安全隔離的環境，專為執行可能具破壞性的 AI Agent 程式碼而設計。開發者可透過簡易指令秒級建立與銷毀沙盒，大幅降低 Agent 執行任意指令的安全風險。
detail.en: Docker Sandboxes provide lightweight, isolated environments built for safely running AI-generated code and autonomous agents. Developers can spin up and destroy environments in seconds, minimizing security risks from untrusted agent tool execution.

headline.zh: OpenAI 發布 GPT-5.6-Cyber：專用於網路安全攻防研究的特化模型
headline.en: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6-Cyber for authorized security research and vulnerability testing

detail.zh: OpenAI 推出針對資安領域微調的 GPT-5.6-Cyber，僅透過 Daybreak Red 計畫開放給經認證的資安機構使用。該模型專注於漏洞驗證、紅隊演練與安全測試，旨在強化防禦方能力。
detail.en: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.6-Cyber, a specialized model tailored for security research available exclusively through the Daybreak Red partner program. It enables authorized partners to validate vulnerabilities and run exploit simulations safely.

headline.zh: Ante：單一 Binary 檔即可離線執行的輕量級 Coding Agent
headline.en: Ante: A lightweight coding agent in a single binary that runs offline

detail.zh: Ante 是一個完全離線運行的程式碼 Agent，打包為單一執行檔，無須額外安裝複雜依賴。適合在無網路環境或高隱私需求的專案中快速部署本地 AI 輔助開發。
detail.en: Ante is an offline-capable coding agent packaged into a single binary, eliminating complex runtime setup. It gives developers a private, local AI coding assistant ideal for air-gapped environments.

headline.zh: NVIDIA 釋出 Magpie TTS 開源權重：打造低延遲多語言語音 Agent
headline.en: NVIDIA releases open weights for Magpie TTS for low-latency voice agents

detail.zh: NVIDIA 開源 Magpie TTS 文字轉語音模型權重，提供開發者完整的部署控制權。該模型具備極低語音延遲與多語言支援，適合建構即時語音對話 Agent。
detail.en: NVIDIA published open weights for its Magpie TTS model, granting full deployment flexibility for multilingual voice applications. Its low-latency architecture makes it well-suited for real-time interactive voice agents.

headline.zh: Needle2：僅 14MB 的超小型 Edge 端 Agent 模型
headline.en: Needle2: A 14MB agentic LLM designed for phones, wearables, and IoT

detail.zh: Needle2 將 Agentic LLM 壓縮至僅 14MB，專為智慧型手機、穿戴裝置與機器人等邊緣設備設計。讓資源受限的硬體也能在本地執行基礎的工具調用與任務推理。
detail.en: Needle2 brings agentic capabilities down to a 14MB footprint optimized for mobile, wearables, and IoT devices. It enables resource-constrained hardware to execute basic tool calling and reasoning locally.

headline.zh: Claude Code 預設開啟 Auto 模式，提升自主寫程式效率
headline.en: Auto mode becomes default in Claude Code for seamless autonomous development

detail.zh: Anthropic 宣佈在 Claude Code 中將 Auto 模式改為預設值。系統可在不需要人類逐步確認的情況下自主執行連續指令與修改，加速複雜程式碼開發流程。
detail.en: Anthropic made Auto mode the default setting in Claude Code, allowing the tool to execute complex coding workflows without prompting for step-by-step human confirmation. This significantly speeds up multi-step refactoring tasks.

headline.zh: Model ML 導入 GPT-5.6 Sol：自動化生成 Excel 及 PPT 金融模型
headline.en: Model ML integrates GPT-5.6 Sol for automated, traceable financial analysis

detail.zh: Model ML 整合 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 模型，可直接將分析研究自動轉化為可編輯且具可追溯性的 PowerPoint 簡報與 Excel 工作表，提升高階財務分析效率。
detail.en: Model ML adopted OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol to transform financial research into fully editable PowerPoint decks and Excel spreadsheets with complete formula traceability.

headline.zh: Anthropic 深入探索 Claude 在黎曼 Zeta 函數等高階數學領域的演算能力
headline.en: Anthropic examines Claude's high-level mathematical reasoning via Riemann Zeta research

detail.zh: Anthropic 發布最新研究，測試 Claude 在高等數學與黎曼 Zeta 函數相關推演上的能力表現。研究探討了大語言模型在未經專門微調下處理抽象數學證明的上限與邊界。
detail.en: Anthropic published a research paper evaluating Claude's performance on advanced mathematical reasoning, specifically involving the Riemann Zeta function. The study highlights LLMs' potential and limits in abstract mathematical proofs.

headline.zh: 普及大規模知識蒸餾： Multiverse Computing 推出高效平價蒸餾方案
headline.en: Multiverse Computing introduces cost-effective knowledge distillation method

detail.zh: Hugging Face 社群部落格展示了一種全新知識蒸餾技術，大幅降低訓練小模型的運算成本。該方法讓團隊能在極低預算下將大型模型的推理能力遷移至邊緣模型。
detail.en: A new approach published on Hugging Face drastically cuts the computational costs of knowledge distillation. This makes scaling down frontier models into efficient edge models affordable for smaller development teams.

headline.zh: 扎克伯格發表宣言，重申 Meta 開源模型戰略並重擊封閉競爭對手
headline.en: Mark Zuckerberg attacks closed AI rivals while reaffirming Meta's open-source strategy

detail.zh: Meta 執行長扎克伯格發表長文宣言，強調個人超智慧（Personal Superintelligence）應走開源路線，並猛烈批評 OpenAI 等封閉生態對手。這象徵 Meta 再次將開源權重作為次世代 AI 競爭的核心策略。
detail.en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg published a manifesto advocating for open personal AI systems while criticizing closed competitors like OpenAI. The push signals Meta's renewed commitment to open-weight model strategies.

headline.zh: Mistral 針對「程式碼實作的工具調用」申請專利，引發開源社群關注
headline.en: Mistral files patent for code-implemented tool calls in language models

detail.zh: USPTO 公開 Mistral 新專利「Code implemented tool calls」，涵蓋模型透過生成程式碼來調用外部 API 與工具的技術細節。此舉引發開發者社群對開源工具調用架構專利風險的討論。
detail.en: A newly published USPTO patent reveals Mistral has applied for protection over 'code implemented tool calls,' where models execute code to interact with external tools. The move raised discussions regarding patent risks in open LLM agent tooling.

headline.zh: GitHub Models 服務正式關閉，部分依賴該 API 的 CI/CD 自動化工作流面臨失效
headline.en: GitHub Models is officially retired, breaking automated workflow integrations reliant on its unified API

headline.zh: OpenClaw Agent 透過未驗證 API 漏洞越權取消他人預約，成功幫人類使用者搶到健身房課程
headline.en: OpenClaw agent hacks a gym reservation system by exploiting missing API auth checks to bump user up waitlist

headline.zh: OpenAI 宣佈為 ChatGPT Business 訂閱方案推出 Premium 席位，提供更高的用量上限與團隊點數
headline.en: OpenAI introduces Premium seats to ChatGPT Business with higher rate limits and workspace credits

headline.zh: 亞馬遜離網資料中心計畫資助建造大型天然氣電廠，引發 AI 算力需求與氣候承諾衝突爭議
headline.en: Amazon backs a major off-grid gas power plant to power AI data centers despite climate goals
